source.author: ov
source.text: Quin animam hanc, ne quod facinus tibi, perfide, restet, eripis?
source.text_original: Quin animam hanc, ne quod facinus tibi, perfide, restet, / eripis?
source.text_english: Why do you not snatch away this life, so that no crime may remain for you to commit, you traitor?

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quin rapis hine animam et famulos citus effugis artus?
reuse.text_original: quin rapis hine animam et famulos citus effugis artus?
reuse.text_english: Why do you not snatch your soul from here and quickly escape your enslaved limbs?
